title: countdown off-by-one range
description: countdown(n) should produce n, n-1, ..., 1 as a list, but it stops one early and omits 1.

files.seq.py:
def countdown(n):
    return [i for i in range(n, 1, -1)]

hidden_tests.test_seq.py:
from seq import countdown


def test_countdown():
    assert countdown(5) == [5, 4, 3, 2, 1]
    assert countdown(1) == [1]
    assert countdown(3) == [3, 2, 1]

fix:
def countdown(n):
    return [i for i in range(n, 0, -1)]
